Fixed in `anthrouter/pace.py`: September 2026 in UTC now gives 22 workdays (it gave 23). A check at 2026-09-15 returns `(45.45, 22)`.

`period_workday_dates` treated `period_end` as inclusive. That value is the first instant of the next month, so Oct 1 (a Thursday) was counted as a September workday. The end date is now the local date of the last instant before `period_end`.

The full suite ended at 3 failed, 1125 passed, 1 skipped. Two of the three, in `tests/test_handlers.py`, also fail with my change stashed, so they predate it. I didn't re-run `tests/test_config.py::test_editable_fields_live_editable_fields`, so I don't know whether it fails without the change. I didn't look at any of the three failures.
